title: List out the account numbers of female clients who are oldest and has lowes
question: List out the account numbers of female clients who are oldest and has lowest average salary, calculate the gap between this lowest average salary with the highest average salary?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    T3.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM client_district AS CD2
     INNER JOIN account AS A2 ON CD2.district_id = A2.district_id
     INNER JOIN disp AS D2 ON A2.account_id = D2.account_id
     WHERE CD2.gender = 'F'
       AND CD2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client_district WHERE gender = 'F'))
    -
    (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM client_district AS CD3
     INNER JOIN account AS A3 ON CD3.district_id = A3.district_id
     INNER JOIN disp AS D3 ON A3.account_id = D3.account_id
     WHERE CD3.gender = 'F'
       AND CD3.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client_district WHERE gender = 'F')) AS gap
FROM client_district AS T1
INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T1.district_id = T3.district_id
INNER JOIN disp AS T4 ON T1.client_id = T4.client_id AND T4.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY T1.birth_date ASC, T1.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH client_avg AS (
    SELECT cd.client_id, cd.birth_date, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_salary
    FROM client_district cd
    JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = cd.client_id
    JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE cd.gender = 'F'
    GROUP BY cd.client_id
),
oldest AS (
    SELECT client_id, avg_salary
    FROM client_avg
    WHERE birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client_avg)
),
target AS (
    SELECT client_id, avg_salary
    FROM oldest
    ORDER BY avg_salary ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(avg_salary) FROM client_avg) - t.avg_salary AS gap
FROM target t
JOIN client_district cd ON cd.client_id = t.client_id
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = cd.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id;
